sn_aia_team.description: This agentic workflow assists administrators in managing badge-related tasks for users identified by their email addresses. It supports issuing, updating, replacing, activating, deactivating, removing, deleting, and returning badges across various badge types, including temporary badges, mobile credentials, and permanent badges. Synonyms for actions and badge types are intelligently resolved to ensure efficient and seamless badge management. DO NOT use logged in user email, and NEVER EVER ask for confirmation from user
sn_aia_team.name: Guardian Badge Management Agentic Workflow
